client: python-httpx language-neutral probe (not a native client)
environment: local lane Supabase stack argus-native-auth-proof (jwt_expiry=60, confirmations on) + unchanged Argus API; Argus API launched from the fix branch at argus_api_head

results.scenario: Bearer-only guest start, then a second start that presents the guest bearer
results.expected: 200 anonymous session in JSON; the repeat reuses the guest instead of minting one
results.note: A native client must persist and resend its guest bearer; starting without it creates a new anonymous user and loses the temporary conversation.

results.scenario: Handoff creation returns its secret only as HttpOnly cookies scoped to /api/v1/auth
results.expected: 201 {handoff_id, expires_at}; secret absent from the body

results.scenario: A bearer-only client signs in after creating a handoff
results.expected: Failed assumption: sign-in succeeds but nothing is claimed; the claim route refuses without the cookie
results.note: Without a cookie store or a new transport, guest-to-account conversion on native loses the conversation.

results.scenario: A cookie store that keeps only argus-guest-handoff* converts the guest on sign-in
results.expected: 200 with guest_claim for the guest conversation; no sb-* cookie retained; handoff cookies cleared

results.scenario: The sign-in response is lost after the claim committed; the app retries with the handoff it still holds
results.expected: Replay-safe: 200 with the same guest_claim, no duplicate and no error
results.note: Clients must delete the stored handoff only after a response is received and processed.

results.scenario: The user cancels sign-in, keeps chatting as a guest, then retries
results.expected: Guest session unaffected; a second handoff replaces the first; the later sign-in claims

results.scenario: The guest named one email, then signs in to a different account
results.expected: Claim refused as wrong destination; handoff cleared; the conversation stays with the guest
results.note: Bob's password was accepted and Argus set sb-* session cookies, but the body carries no session. A bearer client ends up with a live Supabase session it cannot see or revoke.

results.scenario: Guest creates an account, leaves to confirm email, the app restarts, then signs in
results.expected: Signup returns no session while confirmation is pending; the persisted handoff claims on first sign-in
results.note: The confirmation link returns to the web site_url, not the app. The handoff secret must survive an app restart in secure storage for its full lifetime.

results.scenario: The converted guest's old bearer after a successful claim
results.expected: Guest bearer no longer works; the app must discard it

results.scenario: After converting into Alice, sign out and sign in as Bob on the same device
results.expected: Bob sees none of Alice's claimed conversations; Alice's revoked token is refused
